subject: math
description: Construct segments and angles accurately using a straightedge, ruler, and protractor, then check the precision of each drawing.
learningObjectives: Construct a line segment with a given length using a ruler
Copy or mark a segment accurately from a reference length
Draw an angle with a given measure using a protractor
Use straightedge, ruler, and protractor markings carefully
Check construction precision and explain reasonable measurement error
prerequisites: Identify points, lines, rays, segments, and angles
Read ruler markings in centimeters or millimeters
Read a protractor scale in degrees
Understand that construction accuracy depends on careful alignment
